name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
shortDescription: A bilateral Romanian deadlift performed from standing with a barbell.

setup: Stand tall with the bar against the thighs, feet about hip width, and trunk braced.
execution: Push the hips backward with soft knees, lower the bar close to the legs until hamstring tension limits the range, then drive the hips forward to stand.
cues: Keep the bar close to the legs.
Move the hips back rather than sitting down.
Maintain pressure through the whole foot.
commonMistakes: Turning the hinge into a squat.
Lowering farther than trunk and hamstring control allow.

prescriptions.loadGuidance: Choose a load that preserves a controlled hinge and neutral trunk.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
shortDescription: A bilateral Romanian deadlift performed with dumbbells.

setup: Stand tall holding the dumbbells in front of the thighs with feet about hip width.
execution: Push the hips backward with soft knees, slide the dumbbells close to the legs, and return by extending the hips.
cues: Stop when hamstring tension—not the floor—ends the range.
commonMistakes: Squatting the dumbbells downward.
Rounding the trunk to create more range.

prescriptions.loadGuidance: Choose a load that preserves a controlled hinge and neutral trunk.

name: Bodyweight Squat Jump
shortDescription: A bodyweight squat followed by a controlled vertical jump.

setup: Stand in a comfortable squat stance with space to jump and land.
execution: Descend into a controlled squat, jump vertically, and absorb the landing before beginning the next repetition.
cues: Reset balance before the next jump.
commonMistakes: Bouncing immediately through an unstable landing.
Allowing the knees to collapse inward.

prescriptions.loadGuidance: Use bodyweight and prioritize quiet, controlled landings.
